Subject: You’re officially on the books 💛

Hi Casey,

I just wanted to follow up and say how much I genuinely enjoyed our conversation. You have something really special, and I can feel how much heart, effort, and intention you’ve poured into this business over the last year. You’re doing a lot right, and I want you to know I’ve got you from here 🤍

You are officially on the books for Tuesday, and I’m really looking forward to diving in together. Between now and then, I’ve gone ahead and added a down payment option for you so you can secure your spot today without added pressure. From there, I’ll make sure we get you set up with the 3-month payment plan exactly how we discussed, so it feels manageable and supportive, not stressful.

I know you shared how things feel right now financially, and I want you to hear this clearly. You are not behind. You are in a build phase, and you’re a lot closer than it feels. Our job is to come in, tighten what’s already working, and turn what you’ve built into something that actually starts paying you back.

We’re really excited to work with you, Casey. Your energy, your leadership, and the way you care about your clients and your team… that’s exactly the kind of foundation we love building on. This is going to be a really fun transformation to watch.

Between now and Tuesday, if anything comes up or you need anything at all, just reach out. I’m here.

We’ve got you 🤍

Talk soon,  
Bethany
